# FunFact

[![Package and release](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/FunFact/workflows/Package%20and%20release/badge.svg)](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/FunFact/actions)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/265564257347829771.svg?logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/J8wJGtz)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/spartanui-wow/FunFact.svg)](https://wow.curseforge.com/projects/FunFact)
[![GitHub issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues-raw/spartanui-wow/FunFact.svg?logo=github)](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/FunFact/issues)

Share fun facts with your friends in WoW! Over 3,600 facts about animals, food, games, and more.

![FunFact Screenshot](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1505/150/factwindow-png.png)

## What Does It Do?

- Shows random facts you can share in chat
- Pick from 19 different fact categories
- Death Screen: See facts when you die (with funny messages!)

## Death Screen

Die in WoW? Now you get something fun to read!

![Death Screen Example](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1505/149/funfact-png.png)

**Features:**

- Funny death messages (115+ jokes)
- Random facts that change every 30 seconds
- Click the timer to skip to the next fact
- Copy facts to chat with one click
- Role-specific jokes (healer, tank, DPS)
- Shift+Drag to move the window
- Ctrl+Shift+Click to reset position

## Commands

Type `/funfact` or `/fact` to open the main window.

Send facts to chat:

- `/fact party` - Send to party
- `/fact raid` - Send to raid
- `/fact guild` - Send to guild
- `/fact say` - Say it out loud
- `/fact yell` - Yell it!

Test the death screen:

- `/funfact iamsodead` - Toggle death screen
- `/funfact resetdead` - Reset window position

## Fact Categories

| Category    | Count |
| ----------- | ----- |
| USA         | 595   |
| WoW         | 524   |
| Cats        | 496   |
| Animals     | 300   |
| Dad Jokes   | 216   |
| Video Games | 196   |
| Flags       | 176   |
| Dogs        | 140   |
| Food        | 124   |
| Bees        | 115   |
| Dinosaurs   | 200   |
| Movies      | 100   |
| Space       | 100   |
| Myths       | 100   |
| Tacos       | 99    |
| Pizza       | 98    |
| Tech        | 90    |
| Ukraine     | 57    |
| Nachos      | 50    |

**Total: 3,700+ facts!**

## Sample Facts

- Queens have a stinger, but they don't leave the hive to help defend it
- Pizza wasn't popular in America until after WWII
- Cats walk like camels and giraffes
- The Karazhan Crypts contain unused developer test rooms
- Florida has more toll roads than any other state
- T-Rex had the strongest bite of any land animal ever
- The Wilhelm Scream has been used in over 400 films
- Thor's hammer Mjolnir was forged by dwarves in Norse mythology
- A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus

## Support

Found a bug? Have more facts? Let us know!

- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/spartanui-wow/FunFact/issues)
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/J8wJGtz)

[![Patreon](https://www.spartanui.net/img/patreon.png)](https://www.patreon.com/SpartanUI)

# FunFact Changelog

## 📅 Last Month Summary

FunFact now has many corrected typos and grammar in its facts, especially about Bees, Food, and Video Games. The addon also works better with the game's latest update, 12.0.5.

Fixed many spelling mistakes and typos in fun facts, including one video game fact that was broken. This update also fixes a problem with the setting for where facts show up and makes the addon ready for the latest game version.
